title: PSALM 37:4
THE MORNING ALTAR
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: dawn light glowing through bedroom window curtain
mist rising over serene morning mountain lake
golden sunlight touching wooden cabin table peaceful
soft morning sunbeams filling quiet empty room
dewdrops glistening on green grass blade sunrise
calm ocean waves gently touching shore at dawn
peaceful forest canopy with morning light filtering through

scenes.a: Before the demands of this day pull you in different directions, anchor your restless mind right here in this quiet dawn.
Father, as morning breaks over the horizon, teach us what it means to truly rest in Your unchanging goodness.
Your Word commands us with these eternal and life-giving words:
Delight thyself also in the LORD: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
Lord, strip away every selfish ambition and every anxious striving that threatens to steal our joy this morning.
May our deepest satisfaction be found in Your presence alone, knowing that You care for every single need we carry.
